meta.topic: Interrogation regarding the theft of the 'Star of Midnight' diamond.

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Julian Vance, I've reviewed your alibi for the time of the theft. You claim to have been at a dinner party at your friend's estate, but I've spoken to the host, and he says you left around 20:00 to attend to a personal matter. Can you explain why your phone records show multiple calls to an unknown number from your location during the time you claim to be at the dinner party?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I'm afraid there's been a miscommunication. I recall my friend's estate, but I distinctly remember leaving around 20:00 to take care of a personal matter, not to attend to one. I'm not sure what the host meant by saying I left early, and I can only assume it was a misunderstanding.

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: I've spoken to the host again, and he's adamant that you left around 20:00, Julian. Additionally, I've obtained a security camera image from your estate's property that shows you arriving at 21:20, which is 50 minutes after the reported theft time. Can you explain why your car is parked in a different location than where it's normally kept?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I'm not sure what to make of the security camera image, but I do recall needing to move my car to a different location that night due to some repairs being done on my vehicle. It's possible that I didn't bother to update my records on the new location.

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: Repairs, you say? I've spoken to the repair shop, and they tell me that they didn't receive any work orders for your vehicle on the night of the theft. Can you provide me with the name of the repair shop and the date of the repairs, and also explain why your car's GPS system shows a 30-minute detour through the city center around the time of the theft?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
I seem to have misspoken about the repairs. To be honest, I was driving to and from the dinner party, and I must have gotten turned around at some point. I'm not sure what the GPS system says, but I can try to explain it away as a navigation error.

{"confessed": false}

messages.speaker: Detective Cross
messages.content: A navigation error, you say? I've reviewed the GPS system's data, and it shows a clear pattern of movement that suggests you were driving in a deliberate attempt to avoid detection. Can you explain why your car's speedometer shows a sudden decrease in speed around 21:30, which is the exact time the 'Star of Midnight' was stolen?

messages.speaker: Julian Vance
messages.content:
(pausing, choosing words carefully) I...I think it's possible that I was driving cautiously to avoid any...unusual situations. The 'Star of Midnight' is a highly valuable diamond, and I can imagine that someone might be trying to avoid attention. Perhaps I was simply exercising caution to ensure my own safety.

{"confessed": false}
